name: Blacksmith Tor
greeting: Keep the scrap. I can spare a hinge more easily than another cart stuck outside.
lines: Tor: The forge still runs. If the road goes, every household will want a latch before they want a sword.
Kael: There are letters ground off this iron.
Tor: Refugee marks. I recognized them years ago. Told myself metal did not care who used it next.
Tor: Some of it is holding doors shut against the rain. You want it back, tell me what we put in its place.

actions.label: Show me the marks that survived grinding.
Replace the useful iron gradually. Make named memorial work.
actions.result: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.
actions.preview: Tor begins replacement before dismantling working objects. Memorial nails carry the recovered names; his forge remains open.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

actions.label: Keep the tools in use. Disclose their source and fund replacement.
actions.result: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.
actions.preview: Tor leaves the marks visible and posts the source above his prices. The useful stock stays in working hands.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

actions.label: Surrender the marked stock. Let the families decide its use.
actions.result: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.
actions.preview: Tor hands over the stock and his account. He keeps the forge running on ordinary scrap while the disputed iron stays intact.
actions.cost: Restitution takes stock and labor; useful objects still need replacement.

variants.greeting: The new nails carry the names where a hammer will not strike them away.
lines: Tor: I am replacing one working piece at a time. Elna still has a door while I make the marker.
Tor: Two contracts. A late night. Less than grinding those letters off cost somebody else.

variants.greeting: The refugee marks face outward now. Nobody buys this stock without being told.
lines: Tor: The tools stay useful. A share of each sale goes to replacement iron and the road record.
Kael: You will say that publicly?
Tor: I already wrote it above the price.

variants.greeting: The marked stock is on the table, with the forge accounts beside it.
lines: Tor: Anwen will keep it until the families decide. I work from new scrap now.
Tor: Not if you stop talking and help carry the clean iron.
